products.title: High-Pressure Hydraulic Ball Valve, 3/4″ (DN20)
products.descriptionShort: 3/4″ (DN20) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve, rated 5,800 to 10,000 psi. Makes include Gemels and Parker.
products.descriptionLong:
A 3/4″ (DN20) high-pressure ball valve for hydraulic circuits — pump, accumulator and return-line isolation where a process ball valve's rating runs out. The valves in this size are rated 5,800 to 10,000 psi, from Gemels and Parker. We supply them new, with the ends and seat to suit your system.

Makes and models in this size

MakeModel / part no.BodySeatEndsRating (as marked)
GemelsGM316L stainlessPOMBSP (G 3/4)PN400 (5,800 psi)
Parker—Steel——10,000 psi

Each row is what is marked on, or listed for, a valve we have photographed in this size; a dash means it is not stated or not legible. Your valve is supplied to the specification on your RFQ.

Reading the rating

  • PN is the pressure rating in bar at 20 °C: PN350 is 5,075 psi, PN400 is 5,800 psi.
  • WOG is the cold working pressure for water, oil and gas; MAWP is the maximum allowable working pressure.
  • SAE flange ends are rated by code: Code 61 flanges for 3,000 psi service and Code 62 for 6,000 psi.
  • POM seats (acetal) are the usual choice in hydraulic oil; say if your fluid or temperature needs another.

Ordering

Give the size, pressure rating, end connection, body and seat material on your RFQ, with a make and part number if you have one. We confirm lead time and documentation on the quotation.
products.seoDescription: 3/4 in high-pressure hydraulic ball valve, 5,800 to 10,000 psi. Gemels and Parker. Request a quote.

faqs.question: What pressure ratings are available in a 3/4″ hydraulic ball valve?
faqs.answer: The valves we have in this size are rated 5,800 to 10,000 psi cold working pressure; the table gives each one as marked. Tell us your working pressure and fluid and we match the valve to it.

faqs.question: What do PN, WOG and CWP mean?
faqs.answer: PN is the pressure rating in bar at 20 °C. WOG (water, oil, gas) and CWP (cold working pressure) are the rating in psi at ambient temperature. All three fall as temperature rises, so check the maker's pressure–temperature chart for hot service.

faqs.question: Which end connections can you supply?
faqs.answer: SAE four-bolt flange (Code 61 or 62), BSP / BSPP and NPT threads, and socket-weld or butt-weld ends, depending on the make. State the end connection on the RFQ.

faqs.question: Can you supply a specific make or part number?
faqs.answer: Yes. In this size we supply Gemels and Parker, including GM. Give the make and part number on the RFQ and we quote against it.

faqs.question: Are these valves supplied new?
faqs.answer: Yes. We supply new valves to the specification on your RFQ and confirm lead time and documentation on the quotation.
